name: @ap-home/rpc-gateway
description: Chain RPC gateway Worker: per-app tokens (Bearer or ?k=), JSON-RPC method allow-list, per-app rate limit (Durable Object), read cache, optional eth_estimateGas gas-cap injection, forward to a private origin. Deployed infra (apps/*), not a Ring-0 primitive.

scripts.deploy: sh -c 'test -n "$WRANGLER_ENV" || { echo "refusing bare deploy: set WRANGLER_ENV=<env from wrangler.toml>" >&2; exit 1; }; exec wrangler deploy --env "$WRANGLER_ENV" "$@"' --
